stem: Research suggests that selective breeding began about 10 000 years ago. Selective breeding has been important in satisfying the global demand for food.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The introduction of disease resistance to varieties of wheat is an example of selective breeding.

Outline the steps involved in the introduction of disease resistance to varieties of wheat.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Suggest **two** possible disadvantages of selective breeding.
